items.title: Vuori exec to lead struggling Athleta
items.zh_title: Vuori 高管接手连年下滑的 Athleta
items.zh_oneliner: 曾任职 Fabletics 和 Gap 的 Ashley Kechter 将出任 Athleta 负责人，接手这个季度销售额再度两位数下滑的品牌。
items.en_oneliner: Former Fabletics and Gap executive Ashley Kechter takes over Athleta, a brand that just posted another quarter of double-digit sales declines.
